svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 350 mm length of TS35 x 7.5 slotted top-hat rail with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hacksaw; file the cut ends square and remove every burr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rail is 35 mm wide across its top flanges, 7.5 mm high, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 27 mm wide base that lies on the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: three, on the rail's centre line, at the middle and 150 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side. Where a slot already falls within 3 mm of a mark, use

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the slot; otherwise drill 4.5 mm through the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lay the rail on the plate's centre line, ends 5 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate's short edges. Three M4 x 6 mm pan-head screws, snug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every module clips over the two top flanges; the screw heads sit

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.9 mm below the modules, so nothing rubs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rail lies flat along its length; a module clips on and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slides along it from end to end without catching on a screw.
